name: Web design
headline: Design that feels like you.
description: We turn your brand into a thoughtful, easy-to-use digital experience. Clear journeys, considered typography and purposeful interactions help people find their next step.
deliverables: Responsive UI design and interactive prototypes
note: Design systems, page layouts and prototypes are agreed before development.

faqs.a: New brands, growing businesses and teams whose current website no longer represents them.
Design can stand alone or be paired with our website development service. We define the scope in your proposal.

name: Website development
headline: A website with a solid foundation.
description: We build responsive websites that balance memorable design with fast, dependable everyday use. From a focused business site to an e-commerce experience, the build follows your goals.
deliverables: CMS or e-commerce integration where agreed
note: Platform, integrations, hosting and ownership are agreed before the build.

faqs.q: Can you rebuild an existing site?
faqs.a: Yes. We begin by reviewing the current content, platform and migration requirements.

faqs.q: Can our team edit the website?
faqs.a: We can include a suitable CMS and a practical handover in the agreed scope.

name: SEO & organic growth
headline: Grow visibility with intention.
description: We connect technical foundations, search intent and useful content so your website can reach people who are already looking for what you offer. Organic growth is a continuous process, not a one-time switch.
note: Search rankings and traffic are not guaranteed; we report the work, signals and next priorities.

faqs.a: Timing depends on competition, site history and implementation. We agree realistic milestones after an initial review.
Local search visibility and location content can be included in your plan.

name: Digital strategy
headline: Connect the dots before you build.
description: We bring your brand, audience, channels and business goals into one practical plan. The result is a focused roadmap that helps your team decide what to do, why it matters and how to measure progress.
note: You receive recommendations and a roadmap; implementation can be scoped separately.

faqs.q: Do we need a complete rebrand?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. We start with what already works and identify the gaps.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing team?
faqs.a: Yes. Strategy can guide your internal team, existing partners or an Esgrow delivery engagement.

name: Social media management
headline: A more connected social presence.
description: We help brands communicate consistently with content that fits their audience and identity. Planning, creative direction and publishing work together so your social presence feels considered.
note: Channels, posting volume, moderation hours and approval steps are defined in the proposal.

faqs.a: Paid campaigns are scoped separately under ads and performance marketing.
Yes. We agree a review and approval workflow before publishing.

name: Ads & performance marketing
headline: Creative meets commercial thinking.
description: We plan and refine campaigns around a clear audience, offer and conversion journey. Meta and other agreed ad platforms connect with landing pages, creative testing and meaningful measurement.
deliverables: Ad creative testing and landing-page recommendations
note: Ad spend is separate from agency fees. Performance depends on your offer, market, creative and measurement quality.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee sales or ROAS?
faqs.a: No. We agree goals, test assumptions and report outcomes transparently.
Your business should retain ownership. We work through the access you authorise.

name: Web hosting & cloud
headline: Built to stay connected.
description: We help you select, configure and manage hosting suited to your website. Deployment, DNS, backups and monitoring are considered together so there is a clear plan for day-to-day operation.
note: Provider charges, renewal costs, support hours and any availability commitments are specified in your agreement.

faqs.a: Yes, subject to a review of the existing platform, access and data requirements.
It can be bundled or billed separately. Your proposal will make the arrangement clear.

name: Branding & content
headline: A brand people can recognise.
description: We shape the words and visual cues that connect your business with its audience. Identity and content work together across your website, social channels and campaigns.
note: Deliverables, revision rounds, asset licensing and final ownership are recorded in the project scope.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing identity?
faqs.a: Yes. We can evolve your current direction or develop a new identity where needed.
Website messaging and copywriting can be included as a defined deliverable.

name: Maintenance & support
headline: Care that continues after launch.
description: Your website needs attention as your business changes. We help with planned updates, fixes and routine care, with a clear process for requests and priorities.
deliverables: Platform and dependency updates where applicable
note: Response times, included hours, emergency coverage and third-party costs depend on the agreed support plan.

faqs.q: Can you maintain a site you did not build?
faqs.a: We first review the platform, codebase and access, then confirm what we can support.

faqs.q: Is support available around the clock?
faqs.a: Only if specifically agreed. Standard coverage and escalation procedures are set out in your plan.
